en: A black‑and‑white postcard view of a small marina with several moored sailboats in the foreground and calm water reflecting them. Behind the quay is a stone wall, trees, and a large seaside hotel building with multiple gables and balconies. Another pointed‑tower villa appears to the left. The scene has a tranquil, early‑20th‑century seaside‑resort atmosphere. Swedish text is printed along the bottom edge, identifying the boat harbor and the Strand Hotel in Borgholm, as well as the publisher/photographer.
